conditions.name: DunningAlreadyRequestedToday
conditions.description: Prevent duplicate dunning letters for the same IPR on the same day.

conditions.name: HasValidTransactions
conditions.description: Debtor must have at least one valid transaction available for letter generation.

conditions.name: DunningFlag
conditions.description: Dunning Reminder flag must be 1, 2, or 3. If flag is 0, no processing and no log.

conditions.name: DunningCycleCode
conditions.description: Cycle code must be one of 5200, 5201, 5202 for OpenText dynamic content.

conditions.name: AccountBalance
conditions.description: Dunning letter only required where account balance is greater than zero.

conditions.name: CreditControllerDetails
conditions.description: A Credit Controller must be assigned in CloseNet.

conditions.name: DebtorEmail
conditions.description: Debtor Statement Email is preferred. Letter still generated if missing; manual delivery required.

conditions.name: RequestDunningLetter
conditions.description: All required conditions are met and dunning letter is requested to OpenText.
